title: Don't Itemize? Your Charity Gifts Now Count
description: Starting with tax year 2026, the IRS lets people who take the standard deduction deduct up to $1,000 of cash gifts to qualified charities, or $2,000 for married couples filing jointly. Donor-advised funds and noncash gifts don't qualify, so keep your receipts. GivingTuesday is December 1, 2026. Educational only, not financial advice. #givingtuesday #personalfinance #shorts

title: His Toy Factory Burned. Then Came LEGO
description: In 1932, Danish carpenter Ole Kirk Kristiansen started making wooden toys in Billund. A fire destroyed his factory in 1942, he rebuilt it by 1943, and in 1958 LEGO patented its famous brick. #lego #entrepreneur #shorts
